codeReview.summary: The feature adds the requested UI pieces, locales, and component tests, but it does not fully satisfy the contract: the redesigned chat screen never carries an active farm context, retry loses image attachments, and the ai-gateway path still treats attached images as generic text-only context so the assistant cannot actually reason about image content.

issues.description: `useAssistant` is invoked with only `{ language }`, so every request is sent without `farmContext`; the only no-farm handling is `hasNoFarms = farms.length === 0` at lines 189-275. That does not implement the feature's "no farm selected" behavior: users who do have farms but are not in an active farm context get no guidance, and farm-specific queries are still sent with `farm_context: null` instead of the selected farm.

`sendMessage()` snapshots `attachments` and immediately clears them, but `retryLastMessage()` only stores/replays `lastUserMessageRef` (lines 77, 146-150). A failed request with image attachments is therefore retried without the original attachments, violating the contract that Retry must resend the same payload.

The new UI sends image data, but the ai-gateway path reduces any image attachment to the text `image attached by user`; `handlers/advisory.ts` then calls `chatCompletionWithTimeout()` with only `contextBlocks` text. The model never receives the actual image bytes/URL, so VAL-UI-026's requirement that the assistant can reference image content in responses is still unmet.

The updated ChatScreen test file still only covers generic rendering/welcome-state cases (tests at lines 196-319). There are no assertions for the new error banner actions, no-farm banner, attachment picker/send flow, or confirm/cancel navigation, so the main feature paths that regressed here are effectively untested.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `frontend-worker` tells workers to inspect the new assistant components/services, but it does not tell them to compare behavior against the legacy `app/ai-chat.tsx` flow when porting assistant features. That legacy screen still contains the farm-context routing and attachment handling patterns that were lost here.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/frontend-worker/SKILL.md:29-34 only points to `src/components/assistant/` and `assistant-gateway.ts`; compare with `app/ai-chat.tsx:1038-1051, 1766-1768, 2309` where farm context and attachment preparation are preserved, versus `src/components/assistant/ChatScreen.tsx:61-82, 189-275`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared architecture notes describe the redesigned assistant surface at a high level, but they do not capture that the assistant must preserve selected-farm context or that image attachments require multimodal forwarding rather than a text-only context note. That knowledge currently lives only in legacy code paths.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md:22-29 and 93-98 describe ChatScreen/InputBar and the text-chat flow without mentioning farm-scoped routing or multimodal image handling; the missing behavior is only apparent when comparing with `app/ai-chat.tsx:1038-1051, 2309` and `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/context/assembler.ts:103-104`.

summary: Review failed. The feature ships the new citation/error/confirmation UI, but contract coverage is incomplete because active-farm context was dropped from the redesigned screen, retry does not preserve image attachments, and attached images are never forwarded to the model in a way that allows image-aware responses.
